title: Bundle Size Configuration
description: Configuration for bundle size monitoring in the Reflexa AI Chrome Extension

thresholds.description: Size thresholds in bytes for each bundle type

content.description: Maximum size in bytes for content script bundle

background.description: Maximum size in bytes for background script bundle

popup.description: Maximum size in bytes for popup bundle

options.description: Maximum size in bytes for options page bundle

total.description: Maximum total size in bytes for all bundles combined

warnOnIncrease.description: Whether to emit warnings when bundle size increases from previous build

failOnExceed.description: Whether to fail the build when thresholds are exceeded

historyFile.description: Path to the file storing bundle size history

patterns.description: Glob patterns to match bundle files for each type

content.description: Glob pattern for content script bundle

background.description: Glob pattern for background script bundle

options.description: Glob pattern for options page bundle
